title: Why the Tortoise Carries His House
summary: When the animals are invited to a feast, the tortoise cannot bear to leave his fine new house behind — so he makes a bargain he cannot undo.
moral: The home you cannot set down is the home that sets down your feet.
attribution: A traditional Igbo tale, retold for Ubuntu Tales.

cover.alt: A tortoise whose patterned shell forms a small round house among tall forest trees

sentences.text: In those days the tortoise Mbe had a beautiful house with a smooth clay floor and a door that faced the morning.
He had built it himself, slowly, and he was very proud of it.
He was also invited, that season, to a great feast in the market of the next village.
Mbe wanted the animals to see him, but he did not want to leave his house where someone might sleep on the floor or lean against the door.
He worried about it all the way to the market.
He worried so much that he could not enjoy the food, which was unusual for Mbe.
A stranger beside him at the feast watched him looking back at the road.
“You have a fine house,” the stranger said.
“And the road is long.
Why not bring it with you?”
It was a joke.
Mbe did not hear it as one.
He called his friends together and told them his plan.
He would fold the house around himself like a cape and travel with it.
The animals laughed, and Mbe took their laughter as encouragement, which was his first mistake.
The second was asking the strongest of them to help him fold the walls.
They folded the house, and it became a shell; and when Mbe stood inside it, it closed over him and left a place only for his head and his four feet.
He could walk.
He could eat what he found.
He could not climb a hill quickly, or turn round easily, or set the house down unless he first found a soft place and a friend to help him.
The animals laughed again, but they stopped laughing when they saw that Mbe had gone on walking, year after year, with his house on his back.
That is why the tortoise is slow.
He is not lazy.
He is simply carrying more than the others, and he has never found a good place to put it down.
